messages:
sarah_csm: Quick heads-up — AcmeCorp quarterly readout next Tue 3pm PT. Need slide owners and a clear renewal-risk callout. I'll own the exec summary and renewals section. Please confirm who has onboarding status, adoption metrics, and enablement follow-ups. Link to current deck: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/xxxxx (please copy slide IDs into the template). :spiral_calendar:

 taylor_cs: I can take onboarding status + action tracker. Will pull onboarding completion % and outstanding playbooks. Need list of customers who haven't completed enablement lab.

 michael_eng: I'll do adoption metrics — I'll attach perf dashboards (latency, errors, throughput). Can someone grant access to AcmeCorp's prod-project? need by Fri EOD.

 jd_sales: I'll do contract timeline + executive asks. Callout: renewal window opens in 6 weeks. Risk = medium given missing adoption milestones. I can join the dry run.

 alex_ops: I'll capture enablement tasks and feedback themes from CSAT. Also will summarize open RACI for each slide.

 ops_bot: Deck template v2 uploaded — /templates/quarterly-readout-v2.pptx. Reminder set: dry run Fri 10am. :bell: 

 taylor_cs: Added slide ownership to the deck (slide 4 = onboarding; slide 5 = adoption; slide 6 = risks). I'll add a short 3-bullet action list per slide.

 michael_eng: Note: need to include the Impact metric — 30% month-over-month usage growth on the inference API; will include screenshots. Anyone with customer consent for screenshots please confirm.

 jd_sales: Confirmed — Acme legal ok with anonymized screenshots.

 sarah_csm: Great. Action items: 1) slide drafts in deck by Thu noon (owners: taylor_cs, michael_eng, jd_sales) 2) enablement notes + CSAT themes to alex_ops by Thu EOD 3) dry run Fri 10am (all). Can we set up an agenda ~25 mins.

 taylor_cs: Added checklist: [ ] deck draft [ ] slide notes [ ] one-pager for execs. I'll ping if blockers.

 michael_eng: tagging @sarah_csm — will need event logs for two customer tenants; can you request access from infra?

 sarah_csm: request sent to infra-ticket #INC-4271. Ping me if no response by Wed.

 jd_sales: I'll prepare the renewal signal one-pager with suggested playbook (upsell + risk mitigation). Will include suggested discount guardrails.

 alex_ops: I'll run a quick feedback synthesis from last 3 months and add top 3 asks.

 sarah_csm: thanks team. Putting dry-run invite now. :thumbsup: 

 ops_bot: Reminder: dry run scheduled Fri 10:00 — Calendar invites sent to participants.
